anchors.description: Vertical height of one upright book on the bookcase right of the doorway: from the top edge of its pale/white spine down to the bottom edge where the spine meets the shelf board.
anchors.visible_evidence: In the bookcase beside the doorway a pale-white book spine stands vertically among darker volumes; p1 is at the spine top corner and p2 at the bottom corner of the same spine on the shelf line (same x, 22 px apart). The spine fills roughly two-thirds of the shelf gap, consistent with an ordinary book rather than a tall binder.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact format/size not identifiable at this resolution (trade paperback ~0.17-0.21 m vs hardcover ~0.23-0.28 m; could also be a slim binder/folder). Interval spans these possibilities.
